author: drbbton
releaseNotes: 1.2.0: Per-check logging is now an explicit 'Log every check result' toggle (default on) instead of being tied to whether a restart switch is configured. Added self-healing: exception guards around the check chain plus a 10-minute heartbeat that restarts a stalled chain. 1.1.0: Monitor-only mode - with no restart switch configured, every check result (OK and failed) is written to the forensic event log, and the log buffer grows to 500 entries. 1.0.0: Initial release. Dual-endpoint connectivity checks (captive.apple.com + generate_204, both must fail), timestamped forensic event log, modem power cycle via smart plug with fail threshold, boot grace period, and exponential backoff.
